# FortressTV Baseline Profile.
#
# Part 1: generated by the "Generate baseline profile" workflow (run 2, 13 Nov 2026) on an API 34
# emulator without an account: cold start up to sign-in/onboarding, 17,099 rules.
# Part 2: the hand-written rules for the signed-in path the emulator cannot reach (Home, Continue
# watching, posters, guide, playlist and Xtream loading): each class is loaded at start-up and all
# its methods are compiled.
#
# To refresh: run the workflow (or scripts/generate-baseline-profile.sh against a signed-in TV box
# for a profile that also records Home) and replace part 1; keep part 2 until a signed-in run
# covers it.
